schema_note: Repository-specific descriptive index; not an AI-discovery standard
name: Listary for Mac experiment — open-source Rust file-search archive
description: Listary for Mac experiment: independent MIT-licensed Rust/RocksDB file-search engine, local agent, C ABI and optional Python integrations. Reusable source for macOS/Windows search; not official Listary or a finished Mac app.

implemented_component_entrypoints.limitation: Shared search/index orchestration with RocksDB; review cancellation, generations and recovery.

implemented_component_entrypoints.purpose: Connect a native shell to Rust
implemented_component_entrypoints.limitation: C ABI v9, buffer ownership and request IDs; not a finished Swift/AppKit shell.
Resident service protocol and lifecycle; no automatic installer or private index included.
Optional Python/PySide6 and file-dialog/hotkey snapshots; host dependencies are explicit.

implemented_component_entrypoints.purpose: Inspect Mac bridge and acceptance fixtures
implemented_component_entrypoints.limitation: Planning/bridge owner and macos fixtures; physical Mac acceptance remains open.
